# empty.guru — full page index

> The Buddhism shelf and its books. Every canonical page, its human URL, its raw Markdown source, and a short description. Fetch the .md URLs for clean, JS-free text.

- Summary: Every text on the shelf, standing in the century it was written. Pull one out to read it.
